name: unsafe fn from_raw (raw : * mut T) -> Self
rule: For non-zero-sized T, a raw pointer allocated with the global allocator using Layout::for_value(&*raw) and pointing to a valid value of T may be converted into a Box<T> using Box::<T>::from_raw(raw).
api: impl < T : ? Sized > alloc::boxed::Box < T > { unsafe fn from_raw (raw : * mut T) -> Self }
